files.rationale: OpenAI interface metadata and invocation policy are inventoried as provenance; the Kiro wrapper expresses explicit invocation in its instructions without unsupported frontmatter.

Preserves explicit invocation, destination agreement, a compact map index, child decision tickets, blockers, frontier selection, claims, fog graduation, named resolution links, and bounded resumption. Uses the current Kiro session and native planning handoffs with GitHub Cloud or Markdown; restores supplied or established tracker selection and upstream's unconfigured Markdown default. Curates reusable knowledge through the shared OKF lifecycle. Excludes other trackers, automatic backend switching, provider Skill API calls, automatic research branches, and issue-text execution overrides. Publication and prerequisite tasks retain user authority; partial effects, pending capture, and concurrent claims require reconciliation.
